requirements.statement: Extend the package-owned AIDLC bundle service with immutable frozen active-run binding, selector-independent run resolution, bounded read-only legacy-v1 continuation, read-only readiness status, and explicit offline provision service behavior.

path_bindings.ownership_evidence: The completed Phase 2A.1 and Phase 2A.2 runs established this package module as the resolver, projection, selector, locking, and recovery owner; Phase 2B.1 extends the same service boundary with frozen run identity and status.

proof_bindings.asserted_behavior: Binding seals, fingerprint validation, selector independence, compatibility classification, status calculation, and explicit provision behavior are deterministic against controlled filesystem fixtures.

The frozen run binding is a separate closed versioned contract that binds the run identity to the exact project pack, projection receipt, source receipt, project identity, trust posture, and compatibility classification.

An active run remains bound to its original verified pack after future selector changes; invalid bound state fails without mutation; legacy continuation stays bounded; status is read-only; explicit provision remains offline.

positive: A Phase 2A.2 projection mints or reuses one sealed immutable active-run binding and resolves the exact bound pack independently of current.json.
Legacy-v1 continuation is explicitly bounded and read-only, status is non-mutating, and explicit provision reuses the offline projection service.
Focused proof exercises binding, selector independence, integrity failures, compatibility, status, provision, and zero-network preservation.
negative: No operation contacts the network, executes pack content, mutates source bytes, rewrites an existing binding, follows unsafe links, silently upgrades legacy state, or grants new Full authority from legacy state.
Missing, altered, stale, incompatible, conflicting, or unsafe state blocks without changing source, pack, selector, or run state.
This slice does not edit the Requirements adapter or implement Full Start, Planning Lock, MCP, host, schema, registry, dispatcher, or documentation wiring.
